description: This Python script defines a whitelisted function 'get_all_nodes' that recursively retrieves hierarchical node data from the Frappe framework, given a method and a company. It involves permission checks, dynamic method invocation, and recursive traversal of nodes.

methods.name: get_all_nodes(method, company)
methods.description: Recursively fetches all hierarchical node data using a specified method and company, performing permission checks and expanding nodes as needed.
